description: We are a multidisciplinary team of Biomedical Engineering students and researchers from Ecuador (Universidad Politécnica Salesiana / IEEE EMBS) tackling the "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions" challenge. Our core strengths include biomedical signal processing, physiological data analysis, Python, MATLAB, and software development. We are building a clinical telemetry and anomaly-detection dashboard powered by open NASA physiological datasets.
